name: Ġgantija
description: Two megalithic temples on Gozo that went up around 3600 BC — older than Stonehenge, older than the pyramids, and built from blocks up to five metres across. The name means giantess, because nobody could work out how else they got there.
getting: Ferry from Ċirkewwa to Mġarr, then the 322 bus or fifteen minutes by car. Combined ticket covers the site and the windmill next door.
